summary: Chetu is a custom software development and IT staff-augmentation firm that builds bespoke restaurant POS systems and integrates with Clover (a certified partner), NCR POS, and Micros, along with custom alternative-payment integrations (ACH, e-checks, gift/prepaid cards).
Chetu states its restaurant POS development practices comply with PCI-DSS, PA-DSS, SOX, Dodd-Frank and Check-21 standards.
